name: Vladimir Goloborodko
premise: Portfolio manager of the AI Capital Cycle Strategy. His investment judgement draws on two decades leading technology-driven change across enterprise transformation, founding, rapid scale and acquisition integration. He has invested his own capital throughout; the strategy’s live investment record begins in January 2025.
experience_heading: Four seats in a technology cycle
experience_intro: The AI cycle will be decided by how fast enterprises adopt, which new companies find a market, who scales and consolidates, and where committed capital goes. He has worked in each of those seats as an operator, inside the business.

seats.title: Enterprise adoption
seats.role: Programme leader, then head of business unit
seats.body: Ten years leading technology transformations for Fortune Global 500 banks, insurers and telecom operators. Adoption moved at the pace of decision rights, dependencies and economics, not the technology. Then a ~200-person unit of his own: revenue from $7M to $15M, margin from breakeven to about 30%.
seats.application: AI revenue arrives at the speed enterprises can absorb it, so adoption is read from reported results, not forecasts.

seats.title: The founder
seats.body: A payments start-up, accepted into the accelerator, taken through a fundraising, MVP, pilots and pivots in search of product-market fit. The lessons: effort does not create demand, and seeing a weak thesis is not the same as stopping.
seats.application: Most new companies will not find a market. A position is paid for when usage shows up in reported data.

seats.title: The scale-up and the merger
seats.body: One of Europe's fastest-growing online brokers, still run like a start-up. He rebuilt its operating model for scale as clients grew into the millions, and stayed through its acquisition, as two organisations were combined into one.
seats.application: Hypergrowth breaks operating models, so growth is paid for only when the system can carry it.

seats.title: Committed capital
seats.body: A €100M committed-capital fintech investment and venture-building platform with an owner-operator model. He saw where its capital went, built for the growth wave, then assembled five acquired businesses into one product around the economics that worked.
seats.application: Capital committed at the top of a cycle is repriced in the reset. The reset is where the strategy buys.
